title: A 9-month tip is a my-turn your-turn toy pass
summary: CDC's 9-month tips suggest a my-turn, your-turn game of passing a toy back and forth.
body: The 9-month activities include playing games such as my turn, your turn, by passing a toy back and forth. That is a play turn, not the vocal turn on the 6-month checklist. It is a suggestion printed for caregivers, not a milestone that names a percent of children who already pass toys. The page still says the program's materials are not a screening test. Families do this in many ways; the sentence is the US page's example.

sources.title: Learn the Signs. Act Early. milestone page
